input.ticket_title: NullPointerException in PolicyCompiler on empty label set
input.description: Compiling a policy with an empty label set throws a NullPointerException at PolicyCompiler.java:212. Reproducible on localhost with 127.0.0.1 as the target.
input.processed_summary: PolicyCompiler.compile() dereferences a null label collection when the rule has no labels.
input.ticket_summary: An empty label set causes a NullPointerException in PolicyCompiler.compile().
root_causes: getLabels() returns null instead of an empty list for label-less rules
suggested_solutions: Return Collections.emptyList() from getLabels() and add a regression test

input.ticket_title: Collector stops shipping events after upgrade
input.description: Customer uploaded the collector logs. Events stop arriving roughly two minutes after the service starts.
input.processed_summary: The collector authenticates, ships one batch, then stops. Attached logs cover the first five minutes after start-up.
input.ticket_summary: Event shipping halts shortly after the collector starts.
key_issues: Event shipping stops after the first batch
root_causes: The renewal of the shipping token appears to fail silently
suggested_solutions: Log token renewal failures at ERROR and retry with backoff
